convert_notebook_to_mdx: convert a Jupyter notebook to MDX documentation with formatted code blocks and outputs
convert_png_to_jpeg: convert PNG images from notebook cell outputs to base64-encoded JPEG format
build_notebook_cli_parser: build an argparse CLI parser for the notebook-to-mdx conversion command with configurable options
run_notebook_conversion: run batch conversion of Jupyter notebooks to MDX files in a directory with optional Colab links
format_code_example: format Python code examples from notebook cells with max line length and REPL-style prompts
